description: App root and navigation shells differ per platform.
reason: Routing and navigation stacks are platform-specific.

description: Navigation link primitives differ across web and native.
reason: Integrates with react-router on web and react-navigation on native.

description: Home landing in-page section links: smooth scroll on web, plain home navigation on native.
reason: Web uses DOM scrollIntoView and react-router hash updates; native has no document/anchors, so link targets ROUTES.HOME only.

description: Scroll to hash section after navigating to home landing (web only).
reason: Uses document.getElementById and useLocation from react-router-dom; no-op on native.

description: Virtualized list adapter uses different implementations on web and native.

description: Reels desktop view implementation differs between web and native.
reason: Desktop vs mobile reels layout and gestures.

description: Animation wrapper with platform-specific implementations.
reason: Web uses framer-motion library, native provides custom fallback that renders children without animations.

description: Onboarding form hook with platform-specific features.

description: Media carousel component with platform-specific carousel implementations.

description: Message input component with platform-specific UI implementations for iMessage-style experience.

description: Property details neighborhood map: Google Maps JS on web vs react-native-maps on native.
reason: Web uses Google Maps JavaScript API (AdvancedMarkerElement, Street View control). Native uses react-native-maps with Google Cloud Map ID and an external Street View deep link.

description: Property details map overlay controls: Tailwind Box on web vs React Native View layout.
reason: Web uses shared UI Box and Tailwind classes. Native uses React Native View with StyleSheet positioning and pointerEvents for map touch passthrough.

description: Property commute section: shared TSX on web; native uses react-native-maps for the interactive map.
reason: Native uses react-native-maps, Google Cloud Map ID, and Linking for Street View; web uses Google Maps JS API (usePropertyCommuteLocationMap.web) with directions polylines.

description: Commute map legend: inline on web; native module uses react-native View for marker shapes.
reason: Web renders the legend inline with Box primitives; native extracts it to PropertyCommuteMapLegend.native.tsx using react-native View and StyleSheet for dots and squares.

description: Google Cloud Map ID and provider selection for react-native-maps.
reason: Native implementation uses Expo Constants and React Native Platform; web uses a no-op stub.

description: Pros/cons 1–5 star row: Tailwind fill classes on web vs explicit SVG color/fill on native.
reason: Web uses lucide-react with Tailwind fill/text utilities. Native uses lucide-react-native with explicit color and fill props and a React Native View for the grouped image accessibility label.

description: DocuSign embedded signing: web uses iframe, native uses WebView.
reason: Web renders signing URL in an iframe. Native uses react-native-webview to embed the signing experience.

description: View signed document: web uses iframe/window.open, native uses react-native-pdf.
reason: Web uses window.open or iframe for PDF viewing. Native uses react-native-pdf and Linking for external viewer.

description: DocuSign legal/notice banner: Tailwind on web, StyleSheet + design-tokens color() on native.
reason: Web uses semantic Tailwind classes (border-border, bg-accent-muted). Native uses React Native StyleSheet and packages/design-tokens color() helpers; no Tailwind on RN.

description: Multi-stop viewing itinerary editor: web uses AddressInput + Maps Places; native uses TextInput only.
reason: Web relies on DOM-based AddressInput and Google Places autocomplete. Native has no equivalent widget in shared packages; manual TextInput per stop until a shared RN address field exists.

description: Viewing anchors + property stops + debounced route preview.
reason: Web uses @/components/ui Title, lucide Icon, and DOM-safe debouncing for /viewings/route preview. Native uses Text headings, omits web-only icons in dropdown rows, and clearTimeout without window.

description: Agent “request calendar event” body: web uses CreateEventModalForm; native uses an inline RN form.
reason: Web flow reuses CreateEventModalForm inside CalendarEventRequestModal. Native messaging embeds CalendarEventRequestFormCore with ScrollView, RN TextInputs, and mobile Dropdown.

description: External links (mailto, tel, http(s)) in shared UI.
reason: Web uses a semantic anchor with target/rel for http(s). Native has no DOM anchor; opens URLs via Linking.openURL and Pressable.

description: Safe-area padding wrapper for notched devices on native; web is a no-op div.
reason: Native applies padding from react-native-safe-area-context insets; web has no system insets in shared packages.

description: Screen size helper: browser viewport on web vs React Native Dimensions API.
reason: Web reads viewport via platform adapter; native uses react-native Dimensions.get('window').

description: Agent discovery: web dashboard page vs native root-stack screen.
reason: Web embeds discovery in the dashboard layout with lazy-loaded page. Native registers a full-screen stack screen with react-navigation and SafeAreaView.

description: In-app agent profile from messaging/discovery: web route vs native stack params.
reason: Web uses URL-driven AgentProfilePage and public profile hooks. Native uses stack route params (agentUserId) and RN layout without the web dashboard chrome.

description: Account privacy & data export: DOM download on web vs Linking on native.
reason: Web triggers JSON download via document/window APIs and modals. Native uses React Native Linking and has no DOM download path.

description: Toast notifications: web Tailwind shell vs React Native layout and shadows.
reason: Web uses fixed positioning and Tailwind with IconButton. Native uses RN shadow tokens, NativeWind on primitives, and Metro resolves .native.tsx for mobile.
